title: Ladakh Grants Statutory Protection to 23 Ancient Heritage Sites under J&K Preservation Act
summary: Ladakh Grants Statutory Protection to 23 Ancient Heritage Sites under J&K Preservation Act

items: Notifies 23 ancient forts, monasteries, and petroglyph clusters as 'Protected Monuments' across Leh and Kargil.
Prominent Monuments: Maitreya Buddha Rock Carving at Shey, Tingmosgang Fort, Ancient Caves at Saspol, and Chamba Karpo at Diggar.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Ladakh carved out as UT on October 31, 2019 | Lieutenant Governor: Vinai Kumar Saxena.
